response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS face_avg FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(a.face_avg) AS avg_mesh_faces, AVG(a.face_avg - b.face_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(a.face_avg - g.face_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_averages AS a JOIN status_averages AS g ON g.entrystat = a.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.face_avg IS NOT NULL AND a.face_avg > b.face_avg AND a.face_avg > g.face_avg;

assumptions.assumption: “Exceed the overall baseline” also requires each kept site’s average to be strictly above that baseline.

alternatives.interpretation: Only exceeding the access status average determines which sites are kept; the baseline is used solely to calculate the reported difference.
alternatives.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS face_avg FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(face_avg) AS face_avg FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(a.face_avg) AS avg_mesh_faces, AVG(a.face_avg - b.face_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(a.face_avg - g.face_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_averages AS a JOIN status_averages AS g ON g.entrystat = a.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.face_avg IS NOT NULL AND a.face_avg > g.face_avg;
